comment: Reviewed identity of the runtime assets provisioned separately under <Local AppData>/Qronos/RuntimeAssets (never bundled in the installer). 'verified' entries match an official publisher's own published size and SHA-256 (or, only where marked "provenance": "reproducible_build_of_signed_source", the byte-reproducible Qronos build of a signed official source whose recipe ships beside it; never a publisher claim) (Hugging Face LFS oid, or the official release file re-downloaded and hashed); their licence notes are the publisher's text. 'unverified' entries have NO published identity matching the local file and therefore NO hash here (a local hash is not provenance); 'missing' entries are configured but absent. build_support/runtime_assets.py checks an asset folder against this file read-only. Changing an entry is a reviewed change; never edit a hash to match another file.

assets.evidence: official v0.5.1 release asset re-downloaded 2026-10-12 and hashed; size equals the GitHub release API size (no API digest published)
assets.licence: owner-review-required: openWakeWord code is Apache-2.0; its README states the included pre-trained models are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, and names the Google feature backbone as Apache-2.0. Which applies to this feature file is not settled here.

assets.evidence: official v0.5.1 release asset re-downloaded 2026-10-12 and hashed; size equals the GitHub release API size
assets.licence: owner-review-required: see melspectrogram.onnx (upstream calls the Google speech-embedding backbone Apache-2.0).

assets.evidence: official v0.5.1 release asset re-downloaded 2026-10-12 and hashed; size equals the GitHub release API size
assets.licence: owner-review-required: Silero VAD redistributed inside the openWakeWord release; its own licence text is not reproduced by that release.

assets.evidence: project-specific wake head, owner-supplied from the owner's recovered backup (2026-10-16). Structure checked read-only: ONNX IR 10, opset 18, input x float [1,16,96], output sigmoid float [1,1], 9 initializers in qronos.onnx.data. No published identity exists; its local hash is not provenance, and its identity as the original export and its quality are not independently proven (experimental_not_production_ready).
assets.licence: owner-review-required: project-owned per the owner

assets.evidence: external data of the project-specific wake head, owner-supplied from the same recovered backup; every external tensor range of qronos.onnx lies inside it and together they cover the whole file. No published identity; local hash is not provenance.
assets.licence: owner-review-required: project-owned per the owner
